hero.subtitle: Personalized classes to speak with confidence from week one.

about.intro: I'm Gesa, a native German teacher with a degree in pedagogy from the University of Hamburg.
about.p1: Over the years I've taught German and Spanish in very different settings — from the kindergarten at Colegio Alemán in Guadalajara to vocational schools in Hamburg — and that mix of experience taught me something key: there's no single way to learn a language. Every student needs their own pace and their own method.
about.p2: Since 2022 I've been teaching independently, designing every course around the student, just real conversation from day one. I'll guide you step by step along the way.
about.p3: I live between two languages and two cultures, and that's exactly what I want to share with you: not just grammar, but the fluency to hold your own with confidence.
about.closing: Outside the classroom I'm a mom, and when I'm not teaching you'll probably find me doing yoga, near the sea, or walking a dog — the one you see in the homepage photo is part of the team too.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Deutsch Flow we take your data seriously. Here we explain what data we process, why, who we share it with, and what rights you have.
privacy.formNote: By submitting, you accept that we will process your data in accordance with our privacy policy.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
items: Gesa Nommsen — Deutsch Flow (www.deutschflow.eu)
Address: Irun (Gipuzkoa), Spain
Contact email: mehrlernen.gesa@gmail.com

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
items: Contact form: name, email and message.
Student account: email, password (stored encrypted by the authentication provider), name, German level, and, optionally, phone number.
Class package request: name, email, level, notes, chosen package, payment method and language.
German Coffee Break: name, email and notes.
Classes and calendar: dates and times of your classes.
Reviews: if you choose to leave one, your name, rating, comment and an optional photo, which are published on the website.

sections.heading: 3. Why we use your data and legal basis
items: To respond to your enquiries and handle your request: taking pre-contractual steps at your request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
To deliver classes and manage your account: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)).
To comply with tax and accounting obligations: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)).
To publish your review and process your phone number (optional): your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time.

sections.heading: 4. Who we share your data with
items: Supabase (database and authentication), Vercel (website hosting), Resend (email delivery), Stripe (card payments, only if enabled) and the bank in the case of bank transfer payments.

Our database and authentication system (Supabase) are hosted in the European Union (Ireland). Some other providers, such as Vercel and Resend, may process data in the United States or other countries outside the European Economic Area; in that case they rely on appropriate safeguards, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
We do not make automated decisions or create profiles using your data.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
items: We only use strictly necessary technical cookies: to keep you signed in and remember your language. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: 6. How long we keep your data
items: Account data: for as long as you keep your account.
Contact enquiries: until resolved, and for a maximum of 12 months.
Billing data: for the legally applicable periods (6 years).
Reviews: until you request their removal.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
items: You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability of your data, and withdraw your consent, by writing to mehrlernen.gesa@gmail.com. We will respond to your request within a maximum of one month.
If you believe we are not processing your data correctly, you can file a complaint with the supervisory authority: Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD, www.aepd.es).

sections.heading: 8. Minors and security
items: If you are a minor, we need the authorisation of your parent or legal guardian.
We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
items: We may update this policy. The date of the last update appears at the top.
